text:
kai: Heads up — EU canary for user-session-service paused by deploy-bot due to HPA churn during scale-up

deploy-bot: [promote] paused at 10%
deploy-bot: reason: rapid HPA rescale events detected; metrics-server returning errors
```
kubectl get hpa user-session -n prod-eu -o yaml
# Events show FailedGetMetrics and rapid SuccessfulRescale messages
```

stella: metrics-server in EU has transient failures after yesterday's infra PR changed scrape concurrency

kai: release bumped defaults: hpa.minReplicas 2->5 and targetCPU 40. That looks aggressive for a canary footprint

product: any customer impact so far?

stella: we saw brief 500s during preprod flapping at 03:12 UTC. Customers not widely impacted yet but could escalate when global traffic shifts

ops: infra team is investigating metrics API; ETA unclear (~30-90m)

kai: options: rollback to 1.7.2, pin HPA values for EU canary and resume, or keep pause and wait for infra fix

stella: recommend pin to reduce blast radius. quick override: `--set hpa.minReplicas=2 --set hpa.targetCPU=60`

kai: agree. pin + monitor 15m then global promote if stable. Add tech debt note to release notes

stella: opening PR with pinned values and helm promote command in description
```
helm upgrade --install user-session ./charts/user-session --version 1.8.0 -f values-eu.yaml --set hpa.minReplicas=2 --set hpa.targetCPU=60 --wait
```

stella: PR opened: github.com/redwood/release/pulls/2893 (assigning @kai)
kai: quick review: preupgrade migration job guarded behind .Values.migrations.enabled == false in EU values, so safe
deploy-bot: will resume promotion once PR merged

stella: merged PR 2893 -> deploy-bot acknowledged
deploy-bot: EU canary promotion resumed; pods scaling to 4 and stabilizing; healthchecks passing

kai: monitoring 15m. If 99p latency or error rate spikes -> manual hold and rollback

ops: metrics-server alerts reduced after lowering scrape concurrency. infra/monitoring#78 created for postmortem and revert plan

deploy-bot: EU canary promotion succeeded; auto-promote to global scheduled in 20m

product: adding release-note blurb: "user-session 1.8.0: EU canary promoted with temporary HPA override due to transient metrics-server instability. No customer action required. Platform will revert HPA defaults after metrics stability confirmed."

kai: good. ops to track infra/monitoring#78 and schedule revert. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
